questionEn: What is characteristic specifically of “General characteristics of oxygen”, and not of a related concept?
questionUz: "Kislorodning umumiy xususiyatlari" ga tegishli tushuncha emas, balki nima xosdir?
choicesEn: Oxygen (in Latin Oxygenium) – O, Located in group VI of the periodic system of Mendeleev; Aatomic.
A complex substance of two elements, one of which is oxygen
choicesUz: Kislorod (lotincha Oxygenium) – O, Mendeleyev davriy sistemasining VI guruhida joylashgan; Atom.
Ikki elementdan iborat murakkab modda, ulardan biri kislorod
explanationEn: Oxygen (in Latin Oxygenium) – O, Located in group VI of the periodic system of Mendeleev; Atomic number 8, relative atomic mass 15.9994.
explanationUz: Kislorod (lotincha Oxygenium) – O, Mendeleyev davriy sistemasining VI guruhida joylashgan; Atom raqami 8, nisbiy atom massasi 15,9994.
